about: Where the prisoner's arms are, traced off prisoner.png's silhouette runs, in RIG px (the 512x1024 frame the texture is stretched into). Read by design/build_cast_guy_rig.py (--report, and it refuses to write a rig under own_floor) and by design/check_cast_motion.mjs rule 11. Belongs to the DRAWING: redraw the prisoner and these must be re-traced. Arm polygons stop at the seam with the jacket so they only ever contain sleeve and hand; the spill strips are torso beside each arm that should stay on the spine.
